dct_title_s: West Indies, the Bahamas, Great Inagua Island and Little Inagua island (Raster Image)
dct_description_sm: Prepared and published by the National Imagery and Mapping Agency. Depths shown by isolines and soundings. Relief shown by contours and spot heights. "From various sources to 1995." Not distributed to depository libraries. "Copyright 1998 by the United States government. No copyright claimed under Title 17 U.S.C." "Soundings in meters." Components: Great Inagua Island, northeast part, and Little Inagua Island. Scale 1:110,000 -- Great Inagua Island, southwest part. Scale 1:110,000 -- Inset A. Matthew Town. Scale 1:20,000 -- B. Man of War Bay. Scale 1:35,000. Includes source diagram and tidal information. Map no.26267
This map is part of a collection of scanned and georeferenced nautical charts produced by the National Geospatial-Intelligence Agency (NGA).
